_readme: Licence manifest for every animal recording. A file is only played if it is listed here with a licence that allows commercial use. Example entry: {"animal": "husky", "event": "howl", "files": ["husky/howl_1.ogg", "husky/howl_2.ogg"], "license": "CC0 1.0", "source": "https://...", "author": "..."}. animal "*" = any animal.
